description: GTEx v8 median ABAT expression across human tissues to define affected anatomy
code:
import requests, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research/1.0","Accept":"application/json"})
# find correct gencodeId
g=S.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/reference/gene",params={"geneId":"ABAT"},timeout=90).json()
cands=[(x["geneSymbol"],x["gencodeId"],x.get("chromosome")) for x in g["data"]]
print(cands)
gc=[c[1] for c in cands if c[0]=="ABAT"][0]
r=S.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
        params={"gencodeId":gc,"datasetId":"gtex_v8","itemsPerPage":100},timeout=120).json()
df=pd.DataFrame(r["data"])
print(df.columns.tolist())
df=df.sort_values("median",ascending=False)
print(df[["tissueSiteDetailId","median","unit"]].head(18).to_string())
print(df[["tissueSiteDetailId","median"]].tail(6).to_string())

top=df.head(20)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,7))
ax.barh(top["tissueSiteDetailId"][::-1], top["median"][::-1], color="#4C78A8")
brain=[i for i,t in enumerate(top["tissueSiteDetailId"][::-1]) if t.startswith("Brain")]
for i in brain: ax.get_children()[i].set_color("#E45756")
ax.set_xlabel("median expression (TPM, GTEx v8)")
ax.set_title("ABAT expression across human tissues\n(brain regions in red, liver and kidney rank highest)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
